title: Template: Next.js Analytics Dashboard Runtime Regression Debugging
goal: Investigate and fix a real Next.js analytics dashboard runtime regression by reproducing deep-link instability, deferring advanced insights until requested, and stopping long-session interactions from accumulating runtime handlers while preserving the real downstream analytics inputs.
skillBenefitRationale: The debugging category benefits directly because the task withholds explicit incident artifacts and requires a browser-first workflow: reproduce symptoms in a live browser, measure stability and code-loading behavior, implement a root-cause fix, and defend against shortcuts that bypass the real runtime bottlenecks.
